title.narrative: Emission Reductions Program in Sangha and Likouala

description.narrative: To make payments to the Program Entity for measured, reported, and verified greenhouse gas emission reductions from reduced deforestation, forest degradation and the enhancement of forest carbon stocks in Sangha and Likouala of the Republic of Congo, and to distribute these payments in accordance with an agreed Benefit Sharing Plan
